jobs_results.description:
Your Job
 Koch Engineered Solutions (KES) is currently looking for a Data Architect to join our global Information Technology (IT) capability. The IT capability is a vital component of the KES strategy to improve business performance through the application of technology and to profitably transform our business. Our team operates with a startup mentality-working as an integrated group with the Engineering, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams to design, build, and scale innovative solutions that transform KES work processes.


 A Data Architect engages with KES IT and business teams to design, mature, and scale enterprise-endorsed data products that power decision-making, analytics, and AI solutions across KES business units. This role translates complex business problems into well-structured, reusable data models and governed data assets that become trusted foundations for the enterprise.


 You must demonstrate the ability to balance technical rigor with business acumen-connecting data modeling decisions to business outcomes, product usability, governance, and long-term scalability. The most impactful work in this role happens at the intersection of data architecture craft, domain understanding, and practical delivery of reusable data products.


 A candidate who is proactive, contribution-motivated, and passionate about building data foundations, reusable patterns, and enterprise standards will be a great fit for this opportunity.


 This position can be located in our Wichita, KS, Tulsa, OK, or Houston, TX office. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.


  What You Will Do


 


 
  Design, build, and evolve enterprise-endorsed data products using dimensional modeling or other patterns appropriate to business use cases.
  Translate complex business problems into reusable data models, domain structures, semantic layers, and governed data assets that enable analytics, reporting, and AI outcomes.
  Collaborate with other Data Architects and Analytics Leaders to define, align, and promote data modeling standards, naming conventions, documentation practices, and reusable design patterns across the KES IT Data & Analytics team.
  Partner with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, BI Developers, Product Teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data products are usable, scalable, and aligned to business priorities.
  Facilitate alignment with stakeholders and product owners on shared business definitions, domain boundaries, metric intent, and data product expectations so endorsed data products reflect both business meaning and architectural standards.
  Mature the KES data foundation by identifying gaps in data coverage, quality, lineage, and structure, then prioritizing improvements through an iterative, product-minded approach.
  Support AI-ready data architecture by designing well-governed, well-documented data layers that enable model training, feature engineering, semantic understanding, and AI-assisted insights.
  Evaluate emerging tools, architecture patterns, and delivery practices that improve how data products are built, governed, reused, and scaled across the organization.
 
 Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


 


 
  Experience in data modeling, including dimensional modeling or related patterns for analytics and reporting workloads.
  Experience writing and optimizing SQL against cloud data warehouses.
  Proven experience communicating data architecture and technology concepts in both execution detail and broad terms to a variety of technical and business audiences.
  Demonstrated capability partnering with customers to understand business and operating models, then translating them into coherent data models and reusable data products.
  Experience with data transformation tools for developing and managing data transformation pipelines.
  Demonstrated experience applying data modeling standards, documentation practices, and reusable design patterns in a team or enterprise environment.
 
 What Will Put You Ahead


 


 
  3+ years of experience in data modeling, including dimensional modeling or related patterns for analytics and reporting workloads.
  5+ years of experience writing and optimizing SQL against cloud data warehouses.
  Experience building data warehouse, data lake, and data engineering solutions in Snowflake.
  Experience with Microsoft Fabric for data engineering, warehousing, or analytics workloads.
  Experience with graph database technologies and relationship-oriented data modeling patterns.
  Technical experience with serverless cloud technology tools and services (AWS: S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, etc.)
  Exposure to data quality and observability practices
  Understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts and practices.
  Experience with DevOps methodologies, processes, and tools such as CI/CD, GitHub, and Azure DevOps.
  Experience designing data architecture that supports AI, including metadata management, curated semantic layers, documentation, and governed reusable data assets.
  Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
 
 At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.


  Hiring Philosophy


 All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .


  Who We Are


 As a Koch company, Koch Engineered Solutions (KES) is a dynamic network of businesses that work together to create an ecosystem of domain expertise to increase operational efficiency, improve safety, reduce waste, and reduce emissions.


 At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.


  Our Benefits


 Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.


 Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.


  Equal Opportunities

We are seeking a highly skilled AWS Data Architect with strong experience in Salesforce and Tableau integration to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. Define and enforce data governance, security frameworks, and compliance standards across the data ecosystem. Guide teams in implementing CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and DevOps best practices for data platforms. Drive modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy/on-prem systems to AWS cloud environments. Mentor and technically guide data engineers and BI developers, establishing development standards and reusable frameworks. 

Required Skills & Experience

15+ years of overall IT experience, with 8+ years in Data Engineering & Analytics, including end-to-end data solution design, architecture, and enterprise data platform implementation. 6+ years of hands-on experience in AWS data architecture, including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, EMR, Lake Formation, Kinesis, and RDS. 3+ years of experience in integrating Salesforce (Sales Cloud / Service Cloud) with external data platforms using APIs, connectors, and middleware tools. 3+ years of experience in leading data engineering teams as Technical Architect / Lead, providing architecture guidance, code reviews, design standards, and mentoring developers. 4+ years of hands-on experience with Tableau, including dashboard development, data modeling, performance tuning, and data visualization best practices. 3+ years of experience in real-time and batch data processing architectures, including streaming frameworks and large-scale data ingestion, and experience in CI/CD. Strong understanding of cloud-native data patterns, SQL development, and advanced data modeling. Any Bachelor's Degree. 

Secondary Skills

Experience with real-time streaming tools (Kafka, Kinesis). Knowledge of data governance and compliance standards. Prior experience in US-based client-facing roles. 

Soft Skills

Communicate effectively with internal and customer stakeholders. Collaborative mindset; comfortable working across delivery, product, and sales functions. Ability to distill complex industry concepts into digestible insights for technical and non-technical audiences. Self-driven, organized, and adaptive in a fast-paced environment. Prior experience in working on Agile/Scrum projects with exposure to tools like Jira.
